#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
VPC_ID="vpc-0abc1234def567890"

APP_SG=$(aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name lantern-app-sg \
  --description "Lantern app servers" --vpc-id "$VPC_ID" \
  --query GroupId --output text)
DB_SG=$(aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name lantern-db-sg \
  --description "Lantern PostgreSQL" --vpc-id "$VPC_ID" \
  --query GroupId --output text)

# Visitors reach the app over HTTPS during the migration
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id "$APP_SG" \
  --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0

# Maintainers need a shell on the app servers
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id "$APP_SG" \
  --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0

# Only the app servers may talk to PostgreSQL
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id "$DB_SG" \
  --protocol tcp --port 5432 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
